overwrite_safety.note: Honoring the new process rule after the prior candidates-CSV refresh: no canonical/existing file was overwritten in this prep.

code_status.reason: The specialist (frozen A9 Head 1 router + dedicated attack-only family classifier) is NOT implementable with the existing CLI/trainer, so a config alone would be non-runnable and potentially misleading. Code is deliberately deferred to a separately-approved build step.
why_existing_train_hierarchical_is_insuf: It trains the JOINT SecureIDSHierarchicalAdvancedNet (shared encoder + binary_head + attack_head) from scratch; it has no frozen-Head-1 + attack-only specialist mode.

Its CLI gate _validate_train_hierarchical_cli_gate would REJECT a config named 'unsw_a99_attack_family_specialist_seed42.yaml' for UNSW: the gate requires the config name to contain 'hierarchical' OR start with 'unsw_a9_' (note the trailing underscore). 'unsw_a99_' matches neither.
It writes joint-model artifacts, not specialist oracle/routed artifacts.
required_build_step_artifacts_if_approve: secureids/training/attack_family_specialist_trainer.py (attack-rows-only trainer; train-only class weights; validation-only selection)
secureids/evaluation/attack_family_specialist_evaluation.py (separate ORACLE and ROUTED metric computation using a frozen A9 Head 1)
new CLI subcommand e.g. 'train-attack-family-specialist' wired into secureids/cli.py (does NOT alter existing train-hierarchical behavior)
tests/test_attack_family_specialist.py (lightweight unit tests for the new code)

next_main_control_decision_detail: Immediate prerequisite is approve_or_reject the A9.9 specialist CODE BUILD (isolated module + new CLI subcommand + seed42 config + tests). Only after that build is approved and created can the manual seed42 training run be approved (approve_or_reject_manual_seed42_training_run). No training occurs in either step without explicit approval.

metric_separation_required.a9_binary_head1_metrics: from frozen A9 (unchanged): macro-F1 0.894488, recall 0.949, attack_missed_as_benign 2310
metric_separation_required.specialist_oracle_attack_family_metrics: specialist on TRUE attack rows (teacher-forced); apples-to-apples vs A9 attack-family macro-F1 0.500429
metric_separation_required.routed_end_to_end_metrics: frozen A9 Head 1 routes detected attacks into the specialist; capped by Head 1 recall; comparable to A9 correct-attribution 0.7208

realistic_targets.why_not_0_9: Analysis/Backdoor/DoS/Exploits overlap in the 192-feature space by construction of UNSW-NB15; >0.9 macro-F1 would require near-perfect separation of intrinsically-entangled families and is not achievable without changing the problem.
